changes_this_cycle: Added five independently verified non-Mundarica discovery leads: Kera Mundari Talking Dictionary, Phillips & Harrison's peer-reviewed Munda Mimetic Reduplication article, BnF's historical Mundari Prodigal Son recording, the British Library Linguistic Survey of India gramophone-records subseries, and the Bangladesh-domain Munda language digital archive.

Preserved source scope: the comparative linguistics article is not treated as general Munda ethnography; archival audio remains historical and item-specific; dictionary/audio/web-archive records are not promoted into cultural facts.

Preserved rights boundaries: Kera Mundari Talking Dictionary explicitly states Kera Mundari community copyright/all rights reserved; public archive and web access do not imply redistribution or commercial reuse; recording-level consent and cultural-access review remain required.
Raised external web-discovery leads from 27 to 32 while keeping the audited MMSC source-identity total at 27 pending deterministic canonicalization/deduplication.
Fixed Streamlit discovery synchronization by replacing the single hard-coded run-2 import with dynamic additive loading of all web_discovery_expansion_*.json files and duplicate-ID suppression.

Updated discovery tests to dynamically audit every expansion file and fail on duplicate IDs/URLs, sequence gaps, rights-boundary regressions, archival-audio misclassification, or false evidence/verification promotion.
Updated the MMSC index and reproducible search log for the new source-expansion run.
